name: Hash Generator
tagline: SHA-256, SHA-512, SHA-1 and MD5 for any text or file.
seoTitle: SHA-256 and MD5 hash generator for text and files
description: Get SHA-256, SHA-512, SHA-1 or MD5 hashes of text or files, and check them against a published checksum. Free, and files never leave your device.

specs.Engine: Web Crypto API; MD5 in plain JavaScript
specs.Files: Hashed on your device, never uploaded

faq.q: Is my file uploaded to be hashed?
faq.a: No. The file is read and hashed in this tab, and the page's security policy blocks it from sending data anywhere.
Only to match a checksum someone published in MD5. It's broken for security uses; use SHA-256 for anything new.
